# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/labels/{id}

Remove a label from an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-337`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |
| id | path | integer | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — User lacks write permission on issues/pulls
- **404** — Issue not found
- **422** — Label ID does not exist

| Rule | Category | Condition |

| User must have write permission on issues or pulls to modify labels | authorization | !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(issue.IsPull) |

- **No write permission (handler)** → repo.DeleteIssueLabel → 403
